profile.name: Giyosiddin Ubaydullayev
profile.headline: AI / Machine Learning Engineer — Computer Vision & Deep Learning
profile.note: Contact fields are demo placeholders. Phone number and date of birth are deliberately excluded — this profile appears in a public demo video.

facts.text: Python — primary language, used daily for model training, data pipelines and backend services.
SQL — querying and schema work against PostgreSQL and MySQL.
PyTorch — training, fine-tuning and evaluating detection and classification models in production projects.
Ultralytics YOLO (up to YOLO26) — object detection models trained and deployed on real video streams.
ResNet and CNN architectures — image classification and transfer learning.
OpenCV — video and X-ray image processing, real-time inference pipelines.
Dataset collection, annotation and augmentation — full cycle from raw footage to a training-ready set.
OCR with EasyOCR, Tesseract and PaddleOCR — extracting text and fields from scanned documents.
Local LLMs and RAG — vector databases, retrieval pipelines, prompt engineering, chatbot systems.
Speech technologies — STT (speech to text) and TTS (speech synthesis) models integrated into voice assistants.
Backend and infrastructure — FastAPI, Flask, Docker, Linux, Git, Streamlit.
NumPy and Pandas — data handling and model metric evaluation (mAP, precision, recall, accuracy).
Building AI systems that run fully offline in a closed network, with no external API calls, to meet data-confidentiality requirements.
AI / ML Engineer at the State Customs Committee, Department of Information Technology and Cybersecurity, Tashkent — September 2025 to present.
Owned the full model lifecycle at Customs: dataset preparation, training, evaluation and production deployment. Shipped more than six AI systems now in live operational use.
Worked with colleagues to integrate models into existing inspection systems, and improved results through hyperparameter tuning and augmentation.
Built a three-stage computer vision pipeline that counts railway wagons and reads their identification numbers automatically.
Wagon pipeline results: detection mAP@50 = 0.994, character detection mAP@50 = 0.995, ResNet18 character recognition validation accuracy = 99.76% across 10 classes.
Wagon pipeline runs at roughly 5 ms per frame on an NVIDIA RTX 3060, fast enough for real-time operation.

Trained a ResNet classifier on customs X-ray scans to determine whether a wagon is loaded or empty — around 95% accuracy, made robust to poor-quality scans through cleaning, balancing and augmentation.
Built detection and classification models that flag dangerous or prohibited goods in hand-luggage X-ray images at around 95% accuracy, highlighting the suspicious region for the inspector.

Built a RAG chatbot over customs regulatory documents: questions are matched to document chunks through a vector database and answers are grounded strictly in those sources. Runs on a local server so internal data never leaves the network.
Built a voice interface module — STT for user questions, TTS for spoken answers — and integrated it into both the chatbot and a physical robot.
Built an ANPR system for border checkpoints: detects and counts vehicles from video, extracts and reads the licence plate, around 95% accuracy.
Built a system that extracts structured fields from scanned documents via OCR and cross-checks them against declaration data, flagging mismatches automatically and cutting manual inspection time.

First place at the international hackathon 'Applying Artificial Intelligence in Cybersecurity', part of the Future Engineers international festival, April 2026, representing Uzbekistan with team DoppiX.

First place at the REAL HOLAT hackathon, March 2026, run by the Agency for Strategic Reforms with GIZ and School 21 — built Geoportal, a Telegram mini-app for geolocated citizen complaints. Won a development grant.
Bachelor's degree in Customs Affairs, Customs Institute of the State Customs Committee, Tashkent, 2022–2026. Worked in the field for one year during the programme.
One-month professional development programme in the People's Republic of China (November–December).
Uzbek — native.
English — B2.
